paragraphs: Markets over the last day: the eight tracked equity indices moved -0.91% on average, with Nikkei 225 strongest (+1.10%) and Nasdaq weakest (-3.04%). Brent crude changed -0.67% to 114.11. Gold changed -3.21% to 3,902.1001. Bitcoin changed -0.93% to 77,051.2812. The US 10-year yield stands at 4.952%, a relative move of -0.74%. Among the firms tracked, Jefferies (-6.24%) and Gold Miners (ETF) (-5.58%) moved the most.
